attach-zugferd-xml-to-pdf.title: Attach ZUGFeRD XML to PDF and Convert to PDF/A‑3B
attach-zugferd-xml-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, embed a ZUGFeRD XML file as an attached file (AFRelationship.Data), convert the document to PDF/A‑3B for compliance, and save the updated PDF.

create-zugferd-invoice-pdf.title: Create ZUGFeRD‑Compliant Invoice PDF
create-zugferd-invoice-pdf.description: Demonstrates embedding a ZUGFeRD XML file into a readable PDF, converting the document to PDF/A‑3 (ZUGFeRD) format, and saving the resulting compliant invoice PDF.

validate-pdf-zugferd-compliance.title: Validate PDF for ZUGFeRD Compliance
validate-pdf-zugferd-compliance.description: Loads a PDF file, checks its existence, and validates it against the ZUGFeRD specification, outputting a validation log.

extract-zugferd-xml-from-pdf.title: Extract Embedded ZUGFeRD XML from PDF
extract-zugferd-xml-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate an embedded ZUGFeRD XML file, and save it to the local file system.

update-zugferd-xml-attachment.title: Update ZUGFeRD XML Attachment in PDF
update-zugferd-xml-attachment.description: Demonstrates replacing the ZUGFeRD XML attachment in an existing PDF with a new invoice XML using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-zugferd-attachment-from-pdf.title: Remove ZUGFeRD Attachment from PDF
remove-zugferd-attachment-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, delete the ZUGFeRD XML attachment, and save the document while preserving all other content.

add-custom-metadata-to-zugferd-pdf.title: Add Custom Metadata to ZUGFeRD PDF
add-custom-metadata-to-zugferd-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf, adding custom metadata entries such as project code and department, and saving the file as a ZUGFeRD‑compatible PDF.

encrypt-zugferd-pdf-with-passwords.title: Encrypt ZUGFeRD PDF with User and Owner Passwords
encrypt-zugferd-pdf-with-passwords.description: Demonstrates loading a ZUGFeRD PDF, setting specific permissions, encrypting it with both user and owner passwords using AES‑256, and saving the protected file.

digitally-sign-zugferd-pdf-with-timestam.title: Digitally Sign ZUGFeRD PDF with Timestamp
digitally-sign-zugferd-pdf-with-timestam.description: Demonstrates loading a ZUGFeRD PDF, adding a signature field, applying a PKCS#7 digital signature from a PFX file, and attaching a timestamp from a TSA server, then saving the signed document.

add-expiry-javascript-action-to-pdf.title: Add Expiry JavaScript Action to PDF
add-expiry-javascript-action-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a document‑level JavaScript action that checks a predefined expiry date and closes the PDF if the date has passed.

set-pdf-open-action-navigate-page-10.title: Set PDF Open Action to Navigate to Page 10
set-pdf-open-action-navigate-page-10.description: Demonstrates how to add a JavaScript open action to a PDF that automatically navigates the viewer to page 10 when the document is opened, using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-level-javascript-alert-to-pdf.title: Add Page-Level JavaScript Alert to PDF
add-page-level-javascript-alert-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a JavaScript action that shows an alert when a specific PDF page is opened, using Aspose.Pdf.

calculate-total-order-amount.title: Calculate Total Order Amount from PDF Form Fields
calculate-total-order-amount.description: Shows how to read quantity and price fields from an Aspose.Pdf form, compute line totals, and write the summed amount back into a Total field.

add-auto-save-javascript-to-pdf.title: Add Document-Level Auto‑Save JavaScript to PDF
add-auto-save-javascript-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a document‑level JavaScript action that automatically saves the PDF at regular intervals using Aspose.Pdf.

draw-star-shape-low-level-operators.title: Draw a Star Shape Using Low-Level PDF Operators
draw-star-shape-low-level-operators.description: Shows how to load a PDF, calculate the vertices of a 5‑point star, and use Aspose.Pdf low‑level graphics operators (q, rg, w, m, l, b, Q) to draw, fill, and stroke the star on a page.

change-pdf-line-width.title: Change PDF Line Width from 1 to 3 Points
change-pdf-line-width.description: Shows how to iterate through each page's content operators and modify SetLineWidth operators to change the line width from 1 point to 3 points using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-background-operators-from-pdf.title: Remove Background Operators from PDF Content Stream
remove-background-operators-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates iterating over PDF pages and deleting specific drawing operators (such as FillStroke) from each page's content stream using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-text-using-showtext-operators.title: Replace Text in PDF Using ShowText Operators
replace-text-using-showtext-operators.description: Demonstrates how to locate ShowText operators in a PDF content stream and replace a specific string with a new one using Aspose.Pdf.

create-bar-chart-pdf.title: Create Bar Chart PDF with Custom Colors and Axis Labels
create-bar-chart-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF bar chart using Aspose.Pdf's Graph API, applying custom colors to each bar and adding X‑ and Y‑axis labels.

create-line-graph-multiple-stroke-styles.title: Create Line Graph with Multiple Stroke Styles
create-line-graph-multiple-stroke-styles.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF line graph with three data series, each using a distinct stroke style (solid, dashed, dotted) by configuring GraphInfo properties.

embed-vector-graphic-graph-into-pdf.title: Embed Vector Graphic (Graph) into PDF
embed-vector-graphic-graph-into-pdf.description: Shows how to create a Graph object, add rectangle and line vector shapes, and embed the resulting vector graphic directly into a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

combine-multiple-graphs-on-single-pdf-pa.title: Combine Multiple Graphs on a Single PDF Page
combine-multiple-graphs-on-single-pdf-pa.description: Demonstrates how to place four separate graphs in a 2×2 grid on one PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, including background shapes and a diagonal line for each graph.

add-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add File Attachment to PDF with Description
add-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Shows how to attach an external PDF file to a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf, including a description and proper MIME type.

attach-multiple-files-to-pdf.title: Attach Multiple Files with Descriptions to a PDF
attach-multiple-files-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed several external files into a PDF, each with its own MIME type, description, and visual annotation using Aspose.Pdf.

list-pdf-attachments-names-sizes.title: List PDF Attachments with Names and Sizes
list-pdf-attachments-names-sizes.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages and annotations, and extract the names and byte sizes of file attachment annotations.

remove-specific-attachment-from-pdf.title: Remove Specific Attachment from PDF
remove-specific-attachment-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to delete a single embedded file from a PDF by its filename while preserving all other attachments using Aspose.Pdf.

update-pdf-attachment-description.title: Update PDF Attachment Description
update-pdf-attachment-description.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, locate file‑attachment annotations, and modify the description of the attached file. The example also shows creating a minimal PDF with an attachment if none exists.

set-pdf-metadata-and-custom-property.title: Set PDF Metadata and Custom Property
set-pdf-metadata-and-custom-property.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, set standard metadata fields such as Title and Author, add a custom property for the invoice number, and save the updated document.

read-custom-pdf-metadata-log.title: Read Custom PDF Metadata and Write to Log
read-custom-pdf-metadata-log.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract only custom metadata entries, and write them to a text file for auditing purposes.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-with-passwords.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Passwords
encrypt-pdf-aes256-with-passwords.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying AES‑256 encryption with separate user and owner passwords, setting basic permissions, and saving the protected document.

set-pdf-permissions-allow-printing.title: Set PDF Permissions to Allow Printing Only
set-pdf-permissions-allow-printing.description: Shows how to encrypt a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and restrict permissions so that only printing is allowed while copying and annotation modifications are disabled.

digitally-sign-pdf-with-pfx-timestamp.title: Digitally Sign PDF with PFX Certificate and Timestamp
digitally-sign-pdf-with-pfx-timestamp.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a signature field, applying a PKCS#7 signature from a PFX file, attaching an RFC‑3161 timestamp, and saving the signed document.

verify-pdf-digital-signature.title: Verify PDF Digital Signature and Retrieve Signer Details
verify-pdf-digital-signature.description: Loads a signed PDF, checks for compromised signatures, iterates through signature fields, verifies each signature, and extracts signer information such as authority, date, reason, location, and contact info.

convert-pdf-to-docx-preserve-layout.title: Convert PDF to DOCX with Layout Preservation
convert-pdf-to-docx-preserve-layout.description: Shows how to convert a PDF file to DOCX using Aspose.Pdf while keeping the original layout, fonts, and tables by using EnhancedFlow recognition mode.

convert-pdf-to-html-with-embedded-images.title: Convert PDF to HTML with Embedded Images
convert-pdf-to-html-with-embedded-images.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF to HTML using Aspose.Pdf while embedding all resources and raster images as Base64‑encoded PNGs inside the markup.

convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-png.title: Convert PDF Pages to High-Resolution PNG Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-png.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, setting a 300 DPI resolution, and converting each page to a PNG file.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-jpeg.title: Batch Convert PDFs to JPEG Images
batch-convert-pdfs-to-jpeg.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through all PDF files in a folder, convert each page to a JPEG image using Aspose.Pdf, and save the images with names derived from the source files.

export-selected-pdf-pages.title: Export Selected PDF Pages to Separate Files
export-selected-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract specific pages, and save each page as an individual PDF while preserving its original size and orientation.

merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks.title: Merge PDFs with Bookmarks Preservation
merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks.description: Shows how to combine multiple PDF files into a single document while keeping the original outlines/bookmarks using Aspose.Pdf.

split-pdf-into-individual-pages.title: Split PDF into Individual Page PDFs
split-pdf-into-individual-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over its pages, and save each page as a separate PDF document.

extract-text-from-pdf-with-line-breaks.title: Extract Text from PDF with Line Breaks
extract-text-from-pdf-with-line-breaks.description: Demonstrates how to extract all textual content from a PDF while preserving line breaks and spacing using Aspose.Pdf's TextAbsorber with Pure formatting mode.

extract-images-from-pdf.title: Extract Images from PDF with Original Format
extract-images-from-pdf.description: The example opens a PDF, iterates through each page's image resources, and saves each image to disk preserving its original format and resolution.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json.description: Loads a PDF document, exports all its form fields to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf, and optionally reads and displays the generated JSON.

populate-pdf-form-from-json-and-flatten.title: Populate PDF Form from JSON and Flatten
populate-pdf-form-from-json-and-flatten.description: Shows how to load a PDF, fill its form fields using a JSON data source, flatten the form to make fields read‑only, and save the updated document.

print-pdf-silently-to-default-printer.title: Print PDF Silently to Default Printer
print-pdf-silently-to-default-printer.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF file and send it directly to the default printer without showing any print dialog using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

print-pdf-range-to-network-printer.title: Print PDF Page Range to Network Printer with Duplex and Paper Size
print-pdf-range-to-network-printer.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rendering selected pages to images and sending them to a network printer while specifying duplex mode and A4 paper size.

add-javascript-open-action-jump-to-page-.title: Add JavaScript Open Action to Jump to Page 5
add-javascript-open-action-jump-to-page-.description: Demonstrates how to attach a JavaScript open action to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so that the document automatically navigates to page five when opened.

add-auto-print-javascript-action-to-pdf.title: Add Auto‑Print JavaScript Action to PDF
add-auto-print-javascript-action-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to attach a JavaScript action that automatically opens the print dialog when the PDF is opened, using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-author-dynamically.title: Set PDF Author Dynamically Using Aspose.Pdf
set-pdf-author-dynamically.description: Shows how to create a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and set the Author metadata to the current system user at runtime.

hide-form-field-with-checkbox.title: Hide Form Field with Checkbox Using JavaScript in PDF
hide-form-field-with-checkbox.description: Demonstrates how to add a checkbox and a text field to a PDF and use JavaScript to hide or show the text field based on the checkbox state.

embed-qr-code-image-at-specific-coordina.title: Embed QR Code Image at Specific Coordinates in PDF
embed-qr-code-image-at-specific-coordina.description: Demonstrates how to place a QR code image onto a PDF page at exact lower‑left and upper‑right coordinates using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp.

compress-pdf-images-optimization.title: Compress PDF Images and Optimize Resources
compress-pdf-images-optimization.description: Demonstrates how to reduce a PDF file size by enabling image compression, resizing high‑resolution images, and applying additional optimizations such as object compression and font subsetting using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-2b.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A‑2b Compliance
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-2b.description: Loads a PDF, converts it to PDF/A‑2b archival format using Aspose.Pdf, logs any conversion errors, and saves the compliant document.

add-xmp-metadata-pdfa-compliance.title: Add XMP Metadata for PDF/A Compliance
add-xmp-metadata-pdfa-compliance.description: Shows how to load a PDF, add required XMP metadata entries (creator tool, creation date, document ID) and save the file as PDF/A compliant using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdfa3b-after-adding-zugferd-att.title: Validate PDF/A‑3B Compliance After Adding ZUGFeRD Attachment
validate-pdfa3b-after-adding-zugferd-att.description: The example loads a PDF, embeds a ZUGFeRD XML invoice as an attached file, and then checks that the resulting document remains PDF/A‑3B compliant, writing a validation log.

convert-pdf-zugferd-to-pdfa3u.title: Convert PDF with ZUGFeRD to PDF/A‑3U preserving XML
convert-pdf-zugferd-to-pdfa3u.description: Shows how to load a PDF containing a ZUGFeRD XML attachment and convert it to PDF/A‑3U while keeping the embedded XML data.

extract-validate-zugferd-xml.title: Extract and Validate ZUGFeRD XML from PDF
extract-validate-zugferd-xml.description: Demonstrates locating the ZUGFeRD XML attachment inside a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extracting it to a file, and validating the extracted XML against the official ZUGFeRD XSD schema.

batch-generate-zugferd-pdfs-from-csv.title: Batch Generate ZUGFeRD‑Compliant PDFs from CSV
batch-generate-zugferd-pdfs-from-csv.description: Reads invoice data from a CSV file, creates a PDF for each record, adds basic invoice text, and attaches the corresponding ZUGFeRD XML file to the PDF.

embed-custom-ttf-font-in-pdf-graph.title: Embed Custom TrueType Font in PDF with Graph
embed-custom-ttf-font-in-pdf-graph.description: Demonstrates how to embed an installed TrueType font into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, draw a simple graph shape, and add text that uses the embedded font.

subset-custom-font-in-pdf.title: Subset Custom Font in PDF Using Low‑Level Operators
subset-custom-font-in-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a custom font, add a text fragment to force its inclusion, and subset all fonts in a PDF so only used glyphs are kept, reducing file size.

hide-toolbar-menu-bar-pdf-javascript.title: Hide Toolbar and Menu Bar in PDF via JavaScript
hide-toolbar-menu-bar-pdf-javascript.description: Demonstrates how to set PDF viewer preferences to hide the toolbar and menu bar when the document opens by adding a JavaScript open action and using Aspose.Pdf viewer‑preference properties.

create-pdf-page-transitions-javascript.title: Create PDF with Page Transition Effects via JavaScript
create-pdf-page-transitions-javascript.description: Demonstrates how to add page transition effects to a PDF by attaching JavaScript actions to each page's OnOpen event using Aspose.Pdf.

add-javascript-calculation-to-pdf-total.title: Add JavaScript Calculation to PDF Form Total Field
add-javascript-calculation-to-pdf-total.description: Shows how to embed JavaScript in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf to sum line‑item fields and display the result in a summary (total) field.

add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Watermark Behind PDF Content
add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.description: Demonstrates how to place a semi‑transparent text watermark behind the existing content on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

secure-pdf-form-filling-only.title: Secure PDF for Form Filling Only
secure-pdf-form-filling-only.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF with Aspose.Pdf so that only form filling is permitted while printing, editing, and content extraction are disabled.

remove-javascript-from-pdf.title: Remove JavaScript from PDF Document
remove-javascript-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to strip all embedded JavaScript actions—including document‑level, page‑level, and annotation‑level scripts—from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

list-javascript-actions-in-pdf.title: List JavaScript Actions in PDF (Document and Page Level)
list-javascript-actions-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to enumerate both document‑level and page‑level JavaScript actions in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, including Open/Close actions and page Open/Close scripts.

convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff.title: Convert PDF to Multi‑Page TIFF
convert-pdf-to-multi-page-tiff.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configure TIFF settings, and convert the entire document into a multi‑page TIFF file.

generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages.title: Generate PNG Thumbnails for PDF Pages
generate-png-thumbnails-for-pdf-pages.description: Creates 150x150 PNG preview images for each page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's ThumbnailDevice.

extract-pdf-text-to-searchable-index.title: Extract Text from PDFs and Build a Searchable JSON Index
extract-pdf-text-to-searchable-index.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to extract all text from PDF files in a folder and store the results in a JSON file that can be queried as a searchable index.

embed-audio-pdf-sound-annotation.title: Embed Audio in PDF with Sound Annotation
embed-audio-pdf-sound-annotation.description: Shows how to create a PDF, add a sound annotation that embeds a WAV file, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-encrypted-file-attachment-to-pdf.title: Add Encrypted File Attachment to PDF
add-encrypted-file-attachment-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a file attachment using a stream and then encrypt the PDF so only authorized users can open it.

set-pdf-creation-modification-dates.title: Set PDF Creation and Modification Dates
set-pdf-creation-modification-dates.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf, setting its creation and modification timestamps to the current time, and saving the updated document.

draw-pie-chart-using-low-level-operators.title: Draw Pie Chart Using Low-Level PDF Operators
draw-pie-chart-using-low-level-operators.description: Demonstrates how to create a pie chart in a PDF by manually constructing paths with low-level drawing operators and filling each slice with a distinct RGB color.

render-pdf-page-to-png-high-quality-anti.title: Render PDF Page to PNG with High‑Quality Anti‑Aliasing
render-pdf-page-to-png-high-quality-anti.description: Demonstrates how to render a PDF page to a PNG image using Aspose.Pdf with enhanced anti‑aliasing settings for smoother lines and curves.

add-password-prompt-javascript-to-pdf.title: Add Password Prompt JavaScript to PDF
add-password-prompt-javascript-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates embedding JavaScript in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf to prompt for a password on document open and close the file if the password is incorrect.

add-signature-field-with-js-validation.title: Add Digital Signature Field with JavaScript Validation to PDF
add-signature-field-with-js-validation.description: Shows how to create a PDF, insert a digital signature field, and attach a JavaScript action that validates the signature when the field is activated, using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and export all its annotations to an XFDF file for external processing or archiving.

import-fdf-data-into-pdf-and-flatten-for.title: Import FDF Data into PDF and Flatten Form
import-fdf-data-into-pdf-and-flatten-for.description: Shows how to load a PDF, import field values from an FDF/XFDF file using XfdfReader, flatten the form to make fields read‑only, and save the updated document.

set-pdf-document-language.title: Set PDF Document Language for Accessibility
set-pdf-document-language.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf, assign its primary language via tagged content to improve screen‑reader accessibility, and save the updated document.

add-javascript-toggle-optional-sections.title: Add JavaScript to Toggle Optional Sections in PDF Form
add-javascript-toggle-optional-sections.description: Shows how to attach a JavaScript action to a checkbox field in an Aspose.Pdf form so that optional sections become visible or hidden based on the user's selection.

create-pdf-table-of-contents-with-outlin.title: Create PDF Table of Contents with Clickable Outlines
create-pdf-table-of-contents-with-outlin.description: Loads an existing PDF, enables auto‑tagging, creates a TOC element, inserts a dedicated page, and configures TocInfo to generate clickable outline (bookmark) entries for each heading.

batch-apply-pdf-password-protection.title: Batch Apply Password Protection to PDFs
batch-apply-pdf-password-protection.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDF files and apply identical user and owner passwords using Aspose.Pdf encryption features.

dynamic-header-footer-pdf.title: Create PDF with Dynamic Header and Footer
dynamic-header-footer-pdf.description: Shows how to add per‑page header and footer text and attach a JavaScript action that runs when each page is opened, using Aspose.Pdf for .NET.

add-auto-close-javascript-to-pdf.title: Add Auto‑Close JavaScript to PDF
add-auto-close-javascript-to-pdf.description: Shows how to embed a document‑level JavaScript action that automatically closes a PDF after a specified timeout using Aspose.Pdf.
